reason: Provides a sidebar site-map panel that organizes discovered hosts and API paths with search, details, visualization, workspace synchronization, and cookie-assisted browser testing; human review is warranted because it stores and exposes authentication cookies to agent workflows.

summaries.zh: 在侧边栏以可搜索的树形地图展示工作区中的主机与接口，并提供详情查看、数据重生成及按域名匹配 Cookie 的测试辅助功能。
summaries.en: Adds a searchable sidebar site map for workspace hosts and API endpoints with details, data regeneration, and domain-matched cookie assistance for testing.

capabilities: Writes and deletes workspace sitemap data
Returns cookie headers to agent workflows
Supports browser cookie injection for authenticated testing
Registers agent tools and web routes
